sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: This example uses the internal loopback test mode of the UART module. This is a very basic loopback that does not use the FIFOs or interrupts. Data is sent byte by byte, then compared to received data in an infinite loop. The pinmux and UART modules are configured through the sysconfig file.

sect1.title: External Connections
sect1.para:
Connect the UARTA Rx port to Tx port for external loopback.
GPIO32 is UARTARX to be connected to GPIO43 is UARTATX
